brief: Implement core/combat_manager.gd extending RefCounted for Godot 4.7. Preload res://core/fighter_ai.gd as FighterAI. Fields: var fighters: Array = [], var active_wave: int = 0, var total_kills: int = 0, var defensive_fire_cooldown: float = 0.0, var enemy_shots: Array = [], var defensive_shots: Array = [], var rng: RandomNumberGenerator = RandomNumberGenerator.new(). In _init(), set rng.seed = 1944. In reset(): clear fighters, set active_wave = 0, total_kills = 0, defensive_fire_cooldown = 0.0, clear enemy_shots, clear defensive_shots, set rng.seed = 1944. Method spawn_wave(wave_num: int, bomber_pos: Vector3) -> void: sets active_wave = wave_num. For wave 1, spawns 2 fighters: one with ai.setup(bomber_pos + Vector3(-600, 200, -1200), -1.0) and one with ai.setup(bomber_pos + Vector3(600, 200, -1200), 1.0). For wave 2, spawns 2 fighters: one with ai.setup(bomber_pos + Vector3(-700, 250, 1000), -1.0) and one with ai.setup(bomber_pos + Vector3(700, 250, 1000), 1.0). Each fighter is a Dictionary with keys: 'ai': FighterAI instance, 'health': 60.0, 'alive': true, 'cooldown': 0.0, 'fall_vel': Vector3.ZERO. In step(delta: float, bomber_pos: Vector3, bomber_yaw: float, mission_phase: String, damage_sys) -> void: delta = clampf(delta, 0.0, 0.05). Clear enemy_shots and defensive_shots at the start of each step. Wave spawning logic: if active_wave == 0 and mission_phase == 'APROXIMACION' and bomber_pos.z < -4000.0: spawn_wave(1, bomber_pos). Else if active_wave == 1 and mission_phase == 'REGRESO' and bomber_pos.z > -22000.0: spawn_wave(2, bomber_pos). Update each fighter in fighters: if fighter['alive']: fighter['cooldown'] -= delta; var ai = fighter['ai']; ai.step(delta, bomber_pos); var dist: float = ai.position.distance_to(bomber_pos); if ai.is_attacking() and dist < 700.0 and fighter['cooldown'] <= 0.0: fighter['cooldown'] = 0.4; enemy_shots.append({'origin': ai.position, 'target': bomber_pos}); if damage_sys != null: var target_engine: int = int(rng.randi_range(0, 3)); damage_sys.apply_damage(0.45, target_engine); else: var fall = fighter['fall_vel'] as Vector3; fall += Vector3(0.0, -9.8, 0.0) * delta; fighter['fall_vel'] = fall; var ai = fighter['ai']; ai.position += fall * delta. Update defensive fire: defensive_fire_cooldown -= delta; var nearest_idx: int = -1; var nearest_dist: float = 999999.0; for i in range(fighters.size()): if fighters[i]['alive']: var d: float = fighters[i]['ai'].position.distance_to(bomber_pos); if d < nearest_dist: nearest_dist = d; nearest_idx = i; if nearest_idx >= 0 and nearest_dist < 700.0 and defensive_fire_cooldown <= 0.0: defensive_fire_cooldown = 0.25; var target_f = fighters[nearest_idx]; defensive_shots.append({'origin': bomber_pos, 'target': target_f['ai'].position}); target_f['health'] -= 8.0; if target_f['health'] <= 0.0: target_f['alive'] = false; target_f['fall_vel'] = Vector3(rng.randf_range(-10.0, 10.0), -15.0, rng.randf_range(-10.0, 10.0)); total_kills += 1.
